global_manifest.fftw_plan_note: GSHTrans/FFTW transform plans are thread-local and initialize lazily on each worker's first inverse transform; that setup is included in that worker's first GSH inverse/FFT duration, not the serial grid-construction interval.

global_manifest.worker_timing_note: Per-worker durations overlap in wall time and their sums are not a non-overlapping CPU-time measure. Total wall includes serial context setup and worker execution.
global_manifest.memory_note: Preflight charges a Stored Wigner table once as shared immutable grid memory, or Generated-mode angular scratch per worker; per-worker bounds include twelve complex fields, a frequency-result buffer, full-side accumulator, twelve coefficient arrays, two frame Wigners and phase/norm caches, chosen same-spin batch scratch, reader metadata, per-inner-thread Generated Wigner TLS and conservative FFT input/output buffers, and configured transform scratch reserve. observed_process_peaks.interpretation: Supervisor sampled peaks are reported without a minimum gate; short jobs may finish between samples.

claim_limits: Bookkeeping completion is not scientific acceptance.
Original-global 2e-13 gate remains failed; internal thread/storage parity is diagnostic.
No figures or 179-side global volume generated in this phase.
Resolution comparison uses approximate angular interpolation, not a convergence certificate.
Kernel probes use only the first 64 angular points for each L and are diagnostics, not full global kernels.
L128/L384/L1536 cases are not a degree-convergence or representative global-throughput claim.
The physical spatial grid is 64*179=11456 points; tensor_volume_point_count=595712 counts 52 frequency visits.
All current kernel probes are contacts-off, volume-only diagnostics; separate source-shell contacts are omitted, so this is not a full physical global dJ certificate.
YSpec waveform jobs are independent forward solves; YSpec kernel-probe energies use the shared DSpec baseline and are not treated as independent waveform energies.
Radial comparisons use exact state-bound shared sampling files; no interpolation is performed between radii or across interfaces.
Counters such as modal_lmax and solver_degree are accumulated counts; actual degree is in result metadata.
Native/profiled wall-time differences are single-pass apparent measurements, not statistical estimates.
MATHPROFILE inclusive scopes overlap; only exclusive stage sums are used for root-closure accounting.
